title: Update 23.1 for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central 2023 Release Wave 2
summary: Update 23.1 for Business Central 2023 Release Wave 2 introduces Business Central virtual tables on Dataverse, Copilot-assisted marketing text and bank reconciliation, general ledger posting aggregations, cloud migration filtering, and inline error actions. It includes hotfixes and localization updates for Spain.
features: Business Central virtual tables on Dataverse
Power Pages support via virtual tables
Include or exclude tables from cloud migration
Inline error actions in validation dialogs
